headline: St. Mary's put ten past Sul Ross State
dek: St. Mary's had scored three goals in their first three matches and lost two of them. Sul Ross State have now lost all four of theirs, and their keeper Fernando Hernandez has made twenty-six saves without a clean sheet.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Ten different players have scored Midwestern State's nineteen goals, and Jose Ortiz has six of them.

wire.line: Sul Ross State have conceded twenty-one goals in four matches and are yet to score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches are past their date with no result published: Lubbock Christian's against Western Texas, Southwest and Hardin-Simmons, St. Edward's against Southwestern, UT Dallas's at Ouachita Baptist, and Oklahoma Christian's against Oklahoma Panhandle State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Midwestern State have won four and drawn two, and have conceded six goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Dallas have won four, drawn one and lost one, and their twelve goals are more than St. Edward's and West Texas A&M have scored together.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Dallas Baptist had gone four matches without defeat since losing their opener to UT Tyler; the home defeat to Seattle Pacific leaves them with three wins, one draw and two defeats.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Oklahoma Christian won their first three matches and have lost the three since.

last_match.line: Dallas Baptist's first defeat since their opening match against UT Tyler; they had won at Harding, Ouachita Baptist and Colorado School of Mines in between.

next_match.line: Sul Ross State have yet to score this season; UT Dallas have not lost since Hawaii Hilo, though their match at Ouachita Baptist still has no result published.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
